argv:
import json, sys
sys.path.insert(0, "scripts")
import probe_seat as p
sh = open("scripts/probe-seat.sh").read()
assert "search the CLI's GitHub issues for the exact symptom first" in sh, "step 0 header"
assert p.CLASSES == ("ok", "no-turn", "mcp-init-wait", "permission-wait", "input-wait", "auth", "limit", "unknown"), "classes"
src = open("scripts/probe_seat.py").read()
assert "from execute_provider import provider_contract" in src, "adapter argv"
assert "--strict-mcp-config" not in src and "--output-format" not in src and "--add-dir" not in src, "no argv builder"
names = p.mcp_names("Checking MCP server health...\n\nalpha: https://x.example/?token=S1 - Connected\nbeta: npx pkg --key S2 - Failed\n")
assert names == ["alpha", "beta"], names
c = p.classify
assert c("claude", None, "", "MCP server alpha: starting...") == "mcp-init-wait", "mcp wait"
assert c("claude", None, "", "Allow this command to run? [y/n]") == "permission-wait", "permission wait"
assert c("claude", None, "", "waiting for input on stdin") == "input-wait", "input wait"
assert c("claude", None, "", "") == "unknown", "silent hang"
assert c("codex", 1, "", "Error: not logged in") == "auth", "auth"
assert c("agent", 1, "", "You have hit your usage limit.") == "limit", "limit"
assert c("codex", 0, json.dumps({"type": "thread.started"}) + "\n", "") == "no-turn", "codex no turn"
assert c("claude", 0, json.dumps({"type": "result", "num_turns": 0, "result": "OK"}) + "\n", "") == "no-turn", "claude 0 turns, OK text"
assert c("agent", 0, json.dumps({"type": "result", "result": "OK", "usage": {"inputTokens": 0, "outputTokens": 0}}) + "\n", "") == "no-turn", "cursor 0 tokens"
assert c("agy", 0, "OK\n", "") == "ok", "agy ok"
assert c("claude", 0, json.dumps({"type": "result", "num_turns": 1, "result": "OK", "usage": {"input_tokens": 3, "output_tokens": 1}}) + "\n", "") == "ok", "claude ok"
assert c("claude", 0, "", "") == "unknown", "exit 0 no output"
assert c("cursor", 0, json.dumps({"type": "system", "subtype": "init", "apiKeySource": "login"}) + "\nOK\n", "") == "ok", "init event login is not auth"
assert "python3 tests/test-probe-seat.py" in open("tests/run-tests.sh").read(), "wired"
m = open("harness-manifest.json").read()
assert m.count('"scripts/probe-seat.sh"') == 2 and m.count('"scripts/probe_seat.py"') == 2, "manifest"
print("ok")
